description: EARLY ACCESS (returns 403 EMAIL_EARLY_ACCESS until general availability). Schedule an email campaign, or omit scheduled_at to send now. This commits a real send to every recipient on the campaign lists. If it is refused, read "blocked" on the campaign.

confirm.description: Must be true to run this write operation. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time. Omit to send immediately. A past date is rejected.

name: schedule_email_campaign
